title: Shukriya ya fatema
body:
abad wallah ya zahra maaninsa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
matami mujhko banaya aap ne mazloom ka
shukriya ya fatema
meri matti mein bhi rakh di aap ne khaak e shifa
shukriya ya fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bichaya farshe matam hazrate shabbir ka
pursa lene qabr se aayi mere ghar fatema
ye mera kaccha makan bhi rashk e jannat hogaya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil bhatakta tha mera dunya ke gham mein darbadar
aap ne kar ke meri kotahiyon ko darguzar
bakhshwane ke liye karbobala bulwa liya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ka aiwaan khutbe se se giraya aap ne
haq mile ya na mile sar na jhukaya aap ne
nusrat e mazloom ka hum ko dikhaya raasta
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bandhi gardan mein rassi shaah e khyber-geer ke
apne waali ko bachaya zaalimon se aap ne
hashr tak hyder ke lab par hai tabhi ye marsiya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehteram e fatema ka ye mila usko sila
uska qadh bhi ambiya se ek lamhe mein badha
rukh baqayya ki taraf karke ye di hurr ne sada
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke balwe mein bachaya ismat e shabbir ko
tarbiyat yun aap ne di zainab e dilgeer ko
meri behno ko bhi parde ka saleeqa aa gaya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suni maa ne madine mein ye zainab se khabar
ho gaye shabbir pe qurban uske sab pisar
kehke ye ummul baneen ne shukr ka sajda kiya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhte hai ek hasrat se teri tooti lehad
aur bhala darwaish kya hogi kareemi ki sanad
tu ne har ek matami ka dil baqayya kar diya
shukriya ya fatema
matami mujhko banaya...
author: Shahid Baltistani
